      @SchemaFieldDescription("Fields used to create a partition spec that is applied when tables are created. For a field \'foo\', the available partition transforms are:\n\n- `foo`\n- `truncate(foo, N)`\n- `bucket(foo, N)`\n- `hour(foo)`\n- `day(foo)`\n- `month(foo)`\n- `year(foo)`\n- `void(foo)`\n\nFor more information on partition transforms, please visit https://iceberg.apache.org/spec/#partition-transforms.") public abstract @Nullable List<String> getPartitionFields()

    • getSortFields

      @SchemaFieldDescription("Fields used to set the table\'s sort order, applied when the table is created. Each entry has the form `<term> [asc|desc] [nulls first|nulls last]`, where `<term>` is a field name or one of the partition transforms (e.g. `bucket(col, 4)`, `day(ts)`). Direction defaults to ascending; null order defaults to nulls-first for ascending and nulls-last for descending.\nFor more information on sort orders, please visit https://iceberg.apache.org/spec/#sort-orders.") public abstract @Nullable List<String> getSortFields()
